entities.name: Géza Anda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Géza Anda was a Swiss-Hungarian pianist. A celebrated interpreter of classical and romantic repertoire, particularly for performances and recordings of Mozart, he was also acclaimed as an interpreter of Beethoven, Schumann, Brahms and Bartók and admired for his 
technique. Most of his recordings were made on the Deutsche Grammophon label.
